note: The canonical string below was signed with the live Binance spot TESTNET secret and answered HTTP 200 on GET /api/v3/myTrades. The live secret is not recorded; `signature` is that same string signed with `dummy_secret`, which is RFC 8032 section 7.1 test 1 wrapped as PKCS#8 -- published, so the vector is reproducible by anyone and discloses nothing.
unencoded_note: A base64 signature containing `+` was accepted BOTH url-encoded and raw on 2026-09-18. The client encodes it anyway: a raw `+` is a space under form decoding, and whether this venue form-decodes is its choice to change, not ours.
